notes.title: Cavern of Verbs - Update !
notes.content:
The developer has created additional layers to the Cavern of Verbs. These additional layers have battles within them, battles that allow you to practice the words given.
This will allow practice and repetition and space out the influx of verbs, as we had feedback it was too hard and drawn out before.
It was improved because of the recommendations of some wonderful users like yourself.

We are always listening and want to know what you think we should do to improve the educational quality of the game.




Voices are coming soon, however, we ask that you are patient. The developer is a very busy person balancing various life commitments. Equally, the Developer is passionate and wants to do the best for the players and the educational package.

Check out the DLC quiz time, and be prepared for the next wave of voices coming in the future.

notes.title: Japanese Romaji Adventure - 3D remake
notes.content:
Thankyou for playing Japanese Romaji Adventure 3D.



The game has been so well-received that we are remaking the game in 3D!
We will be adding new features, feel free to make suggestions.

This is a great tool to learn Japanese even more, if you played the original.



Please wishlist to know about updates and be notified of the December release:

notes.title: Added Voices!
notes.content:
Konnichiwa!



We've added voice overs for the beginning of the game!

More will be added later, until the game is completed!


We hope you enjoy this added feature and it helps you learn Japanese.
[url=https://discord.gg/99mmypZfYE]Discord Chat for Japanese[/url]




A message from the developer:
This indie project has been a labour of love. Between full time work and raising a little half japanese half western baby we found the time to add sound recordings of the pronunciations. We hope you enjoy the game and learn a lot... Happy gaming folks!

notes.title: Game Updates #1
notes.content:
Thankyou for playing Japanese Romaji Adventure.



Over the last 2 months we have made some updates we've slowly been adding, we are making the announcement public today!

-Fixed any grammar issues (had them checked with English and Japanese teachers)
-Updated the Sound Effects for an authentic Japanese theme
-Updated some music to an authentic Japanese theme
-Added additional small features for battles
-Changed/upgraded some icons
-Fixed minor bugs in the storyine and other areas
-Fixed various minor bugs in the game




Be sure to follow us:
